breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.

There is no mention of using the bending second moment I = π d^4/64 in place of J, which was the error in the incomplete prompt. The specification aligns with the ground truth by exclusively using the correct polar moment J throughout.
